title: Add combined E8 witness at κ = 0.001307044366925301
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Combine the four-replica R705 bit supplier and the retimed eight-replica R560 complex supplier. The exact composition gives **κ = 0.001307044366925301**, **80.637878% above the historical pinned main** ([12a4934](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/12a4934d15006e8c10f9b2264f13f8f341be802b)). This is an exponent-saving comparison, not a measured runtime gain.

Review files: [Proof and scope](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/355d9f7ff293e291676ff4a32eed434419692576/research/e8-combined/PROOF.txt) · [Evidence](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/355d9f7ff293e291676ff4a32eed434419692576/research/e8-combined/certificate.json) · [Source pins and credit](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/355d9f7ff293e291676ff4a32eed434419692576/research/e8-combined/NOTICE).

The bound is conditional. In addition to main's framework, it uses the pending mutable-target, whole-call idle-hosting, and Gaussian-adapter interfaces. All-size compilation, complete-cover execution, restored-work and ordinary-leaf contracts, bad-class portability, and analytic transfer remain assumptions. The proof gives six exact bootstrap steps and sequential finite-cutoff existence; it does not certify complete numerical cutoffs.

The package contains fixed witness data, a concise proof, source attribution, offline reconstruction and independent arithmetic checks, plus one Makefile target and CI workflow. Main's selected-result record stays unchanged. The supplier lineage includes [PR #458](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/458), [PR #462](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/462) and [PR #467](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/467); source pins and OpenAI Codex assistance are recorded in [NOTICE](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/355d9f7ff293e291676ff4a32eed434419692576/research/e8-combined/NOTICE).

## Validation

- `make e8-combined-verify` passed locally and [on Linux with Python 3.11 and 3.14](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38172405255): both words, geometry, phases, owners, costs, all 47 strict inequalities, and certificate agreement.
- Independent supplier audits and a separate rational moment calculation passed. Corruption controls rejected altered witnesses.
- `make selected-record-check` and the complete staged `git diff --check` passed.
- Sixteen of seventeen existing repository verification groups passed, with GCC/Boost retries for macOS tooling. `verify-joint` fails its stored source-hash check (`AssertionError: Makefile`) on unchanged main at [12a4934](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/12a4934d15006e8c10f9b2264f13f8f341be802b).
